text:
maria: quick hit — we need to schedule the PIR for last night's GPU saturation page (root cause: KV cache exhaustion, ~18m of 503s for some customers). who can chair and take notes?

alex: I can chair if no one else is keen. timezone note: I’m PDT.

taylor: I can take notes + produce the timeline pre-read. I’ll assemble logs and the initial triage notes. CET for me.

sam: thumbs up to alex chairing. prefer mornings (PDT) or late afternoons (UTC).

maria: thanks. alex — want me to block a 60m slot, or do we try 45? Customers want a quick follow-up first, then deeper PIR.

alex: 45 should be enough for the PIR run-through and action assignment. 60 if we need to deep-dive.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421-gpu-sat — severity 2. Page start: 2026-04-21T02:12Z, page end: 2026-04-21T02:30Z. Logged runbook events: autoscaler throttle, cache miss spike. Incident doc: https://redwood-internal/incident/INC-2026-0421-gpu-sat

jordan: I’m oncall that week but can attend for the first 30m. prefer 8:30am PDT or 16:30 CET.

maria: proposing two slots to maximize attendance: 2026-04-23 08:30 PDT / 2026-04-23 12:30 UTC (45m) OR 2026-04-23 16:30 CET / 2026-04-23 11:30 UTC (45m). Which works?

alex: both work for me. I’ll pick the 08:30 PDT slot if that gets more PM/SE presence.

taylor: either is fine. I’ll prepare a 1-page timeline + impact table and share it before the meeting (by EOD 2026-04-22).

sam: I can make the earlier slot. 08:30 PDT please.

jordan: earlier slot works. :thumbsup:

maria: ok locking 2026-04-23 08:30 PDT (45m). alex = chair, taylor = scribe/pre-read. jordan + sam + eng-ops invited. I’ll send calendar invite and add the incident doc link + agenda.

alex: agenda suggestion: 1) quick customer impact recap (5m) 2) timeline & root cause (10m) 3) mitigating changes already applied (5m) 4) action items & owners (20m) 5) follow-ups/closing (5m).

taylor: working timeline + logs. quick ask: who owns the autoscaler config change? need owner to present mitigation.

maria: that’s on eng-platform — tagging @alex to loop in Daniel (platform eng). alex can you ping Daniel and ask for a 5m rundown in the PIR?

alex: will do. @Daniel-plat please join for 5m to explain autoscaler throttle and next steps.

jordan: also please surface any customer comms that went out and whether we need a follow-up. I’ll check outreach and report in the meeting.

sam: action item tracker format: please use the template in the incident doc. e.g.
```
- action: short description
- owner: @handle
- due: YYYY-MM-DD
- status: todo/in-progress/done
```

taylor: got it. I’ll seed the tracker with two actions: cache sizing analysis (owner: eng-ops TBD) and autoscaler config rollback plan (owner: Daniel).

maria: RSVP folks: if you can’t make it, add a comment here with proxy or send notes. we want at least one PM + one platform eng + oncall.

alex: I’ll follow up with Daniel + PM. also adding call link to invite.

incident-bot: Reminder: add the PIR facilitator and the postmortem doc tag: #pir-2026-04-23 when the meeting is created.

taylor: will upload pre-read (timeline + logs + tokenized sample) to the incident doc and ping here once done. target: 2026-04-22 18:00 UTC.

maria: perfect — thanks all. tagging for visibility: @eng-oncall @eng-platform @product. :white_check_mark:

alex: confirmed. see calendar invite once sent.

jordan: I may need to duck after 30m but will leave notes in the tracker.

sam: :thumbsup:
